title: Horizon Chart
intent: Create a compact folded area chart for comparing signed time-series magnitude in limited vertical space.
useWhen: Use this recipe when long aligned series need a dense overview and readers can interpret folded bands.
avoidWhen: Avoid this recipe when exact signed values or unfamiliar audiences make a conventional line chart clearer.
